findings.current: That bastard. There was nothing he didn’t know.
findings.defect: The rendering softens the strong profanity in 개새끼.
findings.rationale: 개새끼 is substantially stronger than the generic “bastard,” and the source uses the profanity to punctuate Taekyung’s frustrated realization.
findings.replacement: That son of a bitch. There was nothing he didn’t know.

findings.current: Although I was still lingering at the edge of Peak, Cheongpung and I were both beings who could not be compared to ordinary Peak masters.
findings.defect: The draft makes only Taekyung the subject of remaining at the end of the Peak realm, whereas the source applies that status to both Taekyung and Cheongpung. “The edge of Peak” also fails to convey that they are at its upper end.
findings.rationale: The Korean identifies both men as being at 절정의 끝자락 while distinguishing them from ordinary Peak masters.
findings.replacement: Although Cheongpung and I had yet to move beyond the upper reaches of Peak, neither of us could be compared to an ordinary Peak master.
findings.source: 비록 아직 절정의 끝자락에 머무르고 있지만, 일반적인 절정 고수와는 비교할 수 없는 존재가 바로 나와 청풍이다.

findings.current: Compressed air burst outward, and a violent gale whipped through the area. The spearhead thrust forward with vicious force, while the plum blossoms blooming from the sword’s tip were swept away by the wind pressure.
findings.defect: The draft says only the plum blossoms are swept away, omitting that the wind pressure also repels the thrusting spearhead.
findings.rationale: The repeated particle 도 explicitly places both the spearhead and the plum blossoms under the effect of the wind pressure.
findings.replacement: Compressed air exploded outward, unleashing a violent gale. Both the viciously thrusting spearhead and the plum blossoms blooming from the sword’s tip were swept away by the wind pressure.
findings.source: 압축된 공기가 터져 나가며 광풍이 휘몰아쳤다. 흉폭하게 찔러오던 창날도, 검 끝에서 피어오른 매화도 풍압에 휩쓸렸다.

findings.current:
The Blood Lord’s long fingers pointed to each person in turn.

The three of us had each used one form, making three in total. Just as he said, he had yielded three forms while standing in place.
findings.defect: The source describes one long finger pointing successively, not multiple fingers. The draft also switches from the passage’s third-person viewpoint to “the three of us” before the source returns to Taekyung’s first-person narration.
findings.rationale: 손가락 is singular in this action, and 세 사람 preserves the third-person framing centered on Jeok Cheongang in this section.
findings.replacement:
The Blood Lord pointed one long finger at each of them in turn.

The three of them had each unleashed one form, making three in all. Just as he said, he had yielded three forms without moving from his spot.
findings.source:
혈주의 긴 손가락이 차례차례 한 사람을 짚었다.

세 사람은 각기 일 초를 펼쳤고, 그 합이 셋이다. 그의 말대로 제 자리에 선 채 삼 초식을 양보한 것이다.

findings.current:
This attack had succeeded for two reasons.

Only I could have made an attack like this, using the System. And to the Blood Lord, my attack had not even been worth guarding against.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the source’s pointed contrast between “only me” and “merely me” with an explanatory list, losing Taekyung’s self-deprecating wordplay and weakening the causal explanation.
findings.rationale: 오직 나라서, 그리고 고작 나라서 deliberately repeats 나라서 with contrasting force: Taekyung alone could exploit the System, while his perceived insignificance kept the Blood Lord from guarding against him.
findings.replacement:
It was an attack only I could have pulled off—and one that had worked because I was nothing more than me.

It had landed because I used the System, which no one could have anticipated, and because the Blood Lord had not considered an attack from someone like me worth guarding against.
findings.source:
오직 나라서, 그리고 고작 나라서 가능했던 공격이다.

누구도 예상치 못한 시스템을 사용한 공격이라 통했고, 혈주에게는 경계 대상조차 될 수 없는 내 공격이었기에 먹혀들었다.

findings.defect: The English fragment is unidiomatic and does not work as a natural expletive.
findings.rationale: The source is a strongly profane, interrupted groan; “Fucking hell…” preserves its force and unfinished delivery in natural English.

summary: The draft contains several actionable fidelity issues, including a changed combat outcome, an altered realm subject, a viewpoint break, lost self-deprecating wordplay, and localized profanity problems.
